final_message: Changed `DataArray.integrate`'s primary argument from `dim` to `coord` (matching `Dataset.integrate`), keeping backward compatibility via a deprecated keyword-only `dim` argument that emits a `DeprecationWarning`.

The fix is complete.

I changed `as_compatible_data` in `xarray/core/variable.py` so that the generic `getattr(data, "values", data)` unwrapping only applies to pandas `Series`/`Index`, instead of any object exposing a `.values` attribute. This prevents `Variable.__setitem__` from coercing arbitrary objects (e.g., `HasValues()`) when storing them into object-dtype arrays, while preserving the intended unwrapping of pandas objects.
